data.altTitle: Precision in every pixel. Excellence in every print.
data.subtitle: LINEA - a design and print studio, is a family-run business founded in 1987. The company's early activity centred on photography and the shooting of video films and spots, documentary films, and the creation of designs for various magazines, as well as organising promotional activities for individual companies. Later the business expanded into graphic prepress and printing itself, which we have been doing since 1994.
data.description:
Through continuous investment in technological development and the acquisition of new, modern machinery in the graphic arts industry, we are today able to carry out the tasks set before us quickly and to a high standard. We permanently employ between 26 and 30 people trained and educated for the work they perform, so that every activity is covered by qualified staff.

Production takes place in an 1800 m2 facility of our own, arranged and equipped for the best possible execution of the work. Client reception, graphic prepress, sales and accounting, and the showroom are located in a separate 220 m2 space with secured parking.
data.section3Subtitle: With the high quality of the work we deliver, with professionalism and a sense of responsibility towards our business partners and associates, we will continue to strive to earn your trust so that you choose us as a partner in your business.

data.altTitle: Preciznost u svakom pikselu. Izvrsnost u svakom ispisu.
data.subtitle: LINEA - studio za dizajn i tisak, obiteljski je obrt koji je utemeljen 1987. godine. Početak aktivnosti obrta vezan je uz fotografiju i snimanje video filmova i spotova, dokumentarnih filmova te izradu dizajna za razne časopise kao i organizacija promotivnih aktivnosti za pojedine tvrtke. Kasnije se posao proširio na grafičku pripremu i na sam tisak koji obavljamo od 1994. godine.
data.description:
Stalnim ulaganjem u tehnološki razvoj i nabavkom novih i modernih strojeva u grafičkoj djelatnosti danas smo u mogućnosti brzo i kvalitetno odraditi postavljene poslove i zadatke. Stalno zapošljavamo između 26 -30 ljudi obučenih i školovanih za posao koji obavljaju tako da je svaka djelatnost pokrivena stručnim kadrom.

Proizvodnja se odvija u pogonu od 1800 m2 vlastitog prostora uređenog i opremljenog za što bolje izvršavanje poslova. Prijem stranaka, grafička priprema, komercijala računovodstvo i show room je u izdvojenom prostoru od 220 m2 sa osiguranim parkingom.
data.section3Subtitle: Visokom kvalitetom izvršenih poslova, profesionalnosću i odgovornošću prema poslovnim partnerima i suradnicima trudit ćemo se i u buduće zadobiti vaše povjerenje da nas izaberete kao partnera u vašem poslovanju.

en.title: A major investment in our production facility: greater capacity, new possibilities

content.text: A new investment in cutting-edge technology – expanding capacity and capabilities
Two HP Stitch sublimation printers recently arrived at our production facility –
HP Stitch S1000 (3.2 m)
and
HP Stitch S500 (1.6 m)
– alongside which we also invested in a
Klieverik calender 3.2 m wide
. This significant investment opens the door to an even wider range of products and services.

The new HP Stitch printers enable us to achieve outstanding quality, greater speed and significantly higher production capacity. Thanks to them we can print on a variety of materials – from sports jerseys and fashion fabrics to interior textiles such as curtains. The industrial
HP Stitch S1000
will focus on large volumes, while the
HP Stitch S500
will take on smaller and specialised orders, ensuring continuity and flexibility in our work.
By installing the
Klieverik calender

we have further improved the print-fixing process – with a capacity of 400 m²/h, a stable temperature and low energy consumption. This has made our production faster, more efficient and adapted to greater market demands.

With the support of our long-standing partner Fortuna Digital, we are confident that this equipment will significantly enhance our work and provide our clients with products of even higher quality and greater variety.
Read more about it
HERE

hr.title: Velika investicija u proizvodni pogon: veći kapaciteti, nove mogućnosti

content.text: Nova investicija u vrhunsku tehnologiju – širenje kapaciteta i mogućnosti
U naš proizvodni pogon nedavno su stigla dva HP Stitch sublimacijska printera –
HP Stitch S1000 (3,2 m)
i
HP Stitch S500 (1,6 m)
– uz koje smo investirali i u
Klieverik kalander širine 3,2 m
. Ova značajna investicija otvara nam vrata prema još širem spektru proizvoda i usluga.

Novi HP Stitch printeri omogućuju nam vrhunsku kvalitetu, veću brzinu i znatno veće kapacitete proizvodnje. Zahvaljujući njima možemo tiskati na različite materijale – od sportskih dresova i modnih tkanina, do tekstila za interijere poput zavjesa. Industrijski
HP Stitch S1000
bit će fokusiran na velike volumene, dok će
HP Stitch S500
preuzeti manje i specijalizirane narudžbe, osiguravajući pritom kontinuitet i fleksibilnost u radu.
Instalacijom
Klieverik kalandera

dodatno smo unaprijedili proces fiksiranja tiska – s kapacitetom od 400 m²/h, stabilnom temperaturom i niskom potrošnjom energije. Time je naša proizvodnja postala brža, učinkovitija i prilagođena većim zahtjevima tržišta.
Uz podršku dugogodišnjeg partnera Fortuna Digital, sigurni smo da će ova oprema značajno unaprijediti naš rad i pružiti našim klijentima još kvalitetnije i raznovrsnije proizvode.
Više o tome pročitajte
OVDJE

Project summary

Linea - a design and print studio is investing in improving its website and building an online store with the aim of increasing the competitiveness, profitability and cost-efficiency of its business. Owing to a broad reference list of customers from across the whole of the Republic of Croatia, the Applicant receives a large number of orders every day via telephone calls and emails. With the realisation of this project, orders will be automated through the improved website and the newly established online store, which will greatly contribute to improving the entire sales process. In addition, thanks to a faster and more efficient sales system, capacity will be freed up to increase the volume of business, which will in turn result in higher business revenue for the Applicant. Sažetak projekta

Linea-studio za dizajn i tisak ulaže u unaprjeđenje web stranice i izradu web trgovine s ciljem povećanja konkurentnosti, profitabilnosti i ekonomičnosti poslovanja. Zbog široke referentne liste kupaca s područja cijele Republike Hrvatske, Prijavitelj svakodnevno zaprima veliki broj narudžbi putem telefonskih poziva i mailova. Realizacijom ovog projekta, narudžbe će biti automatizirane putem unaprjeđene web stranice i uspostavljene web trgovine što će uvelike doprinijeti poboljšanju cjelokupnog procesa prodaje. Osim toga, zbog bržeg i učinkovitijeg sustava prodaje, osloboditi će se mjesta za povećanje obujma poslovanja što će samim time rezultirati i povećanju poslovnih prihoda Prijavitelja. data.altTitle: Precision in every pixel. Excellence in every print.
data.subtitle: LINEA - a design and print studio, is a family-run business founded in 1987. The company's early activity centred on photography and the shooting of video films and spots, documentary films, and the creation of designs for various magazines, as well as organising promotional activities for individual companies. Later the business expanded into graphic prepress and printing itself, which we have been doing since 1994.
data.description:
Through continuous investment in technological development and the acquisition of new, modern machinery in the graphic arts industry, we are today able to carry out the tasks set before us quickly and to a high standard. We permanently employ between 26 and 30 people trained and educated for the work they perform, so that every activity is covered by qualified staff.

Production takes place in an 1800 m2 facility of our own, arranged and equipped for the best possible execution of the work. Client reception, graphic prepress, sales and accounting, and the showroom are located in a separate 220 m2 space with secured parking.
data.section3Subtitle: With the high quality of the work we deliver, with professionalism and a sense of responsibility towards our business partners and associates, we will continue to strive to earn your trust so that you choose us as a partner in your business.

content.text: THE EQUIPMENT PURCHASE WAS CO-FINANCED BY THE EUROPEAN REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT FUND
Project title
: Purchase of a 3.2 m printing machine for printing on textile materials
Project description

: Due to outdated and insufficiently efficient technology, the „Linea“ business does not have sufficient capacity to produce the required quantities of its own textile products, which results in inadequate competitiveness and technological readiness for further growth and long-term survival in the market. For this reason it decided to invest in the purchase of a 3.2 m printer featuring the latest technological advances
Project goal and expected result
: By investing in the purchase of new machinery and equipment of its own, the Company plans to grow total revenue by 23% and by 54% on the foreign market, as well as to retain and create 4 new jobs
Total project value
: HRK 561,278.52, with the amount co-financed by the EU totalling HRK 300,000.00
Project implementation period
: from October 2017 to June 2018.
Contact person for more information
: Zdravko Prebeg, email:
linea@linea.hr
www.strukturnifondovi.hr
Uvjeti poslovanja (općenito)
Internet stranice
www.linea.hr

su u vlasništvu obrta Linea studio za dizajn i tisak (u daljnjem tekstu Linea studio). Uvjeti poslovanja vrijede za registrirane korisnike. Registrirani korisnik (u daljnjem tekstu korisnik ili registrirani korisnik) može postati svaka punoljetna osoba koja je potpuno poslovno sposobna i koja prihvaća uvjete poslovanja Linea studia. Prilikom prvog upisa potrebno se registrirati i pritom ispuniti sva tražena polja istinitim podacima. Prihvaćanje općih uvjeta poslovanja kupac potvrđuje svojom registracijom. Korisnik je dužan brinuti se o sigurnosti svoje korisničke lozinke i povremeno je mijenjati. Linea studio ne odgovara za slučajeve zlouporabe korisničke lozinke, ali će odmah nakon što korisnik javi o vjerojatnoj zlouporabi, odgovarajuće postupiti.
Registrirani korisnik ima sljedeća prava:
kupovati artikle na stranicama
www.linea.hr
koristiti stranice
www.linea.hr
u dobroj vjeri i namjeri
Zadržavamo pravo promjene uvjeta korištenja ovih stranica u bilo kojem trenutku.

Promjene stupaju na snagu u trenutku objave. Registrirani korisnik je dužan redovito čitati pravila i uvjete korištenja te se smatra da je pristupanjem stranicama upoznat s aktualnim pravilima i uvjetima korištenja istih, a prilikom potvrde kupnje to i potvrđuje.
Kupnja na internet stranicama

Svaki registrirani korisnik može kupovati artikle iz ponude Linea studia prikazane na internetskim stranicama. Kupoprodajni ugovor između registriranog korisnika i Linea studia postaje pravovaljan nakon primitka naručene pošiljke i vrijedi isključivo za područje HR.
Cijene

Sve navedene cijene ne sadrže PDV i izražene su u kunama. Ponuda i cijene za specijalne akcije vrijede do isteka roka koji je naveden na samoj internet stranici ili do isteka zaliha. U cijenu nisu uračunati otpremni troškovi koji će biti posebno navedeni prilikom naručivanja artikala. Otpremni troškovi se mogu uvećati za dodatne troškove koji mogu nastati prilikom dostave, a prema uvjetima dostavne službe koja vrši tu uslugu.
Jamstvo i servis

Jamstveni rok naveden je za svaki pojedini artikal. Za artikle za koje nije naveden rok jamstva, vrijede rokovi općih jamstvenih uvjeta prema važećim zakonima Republike Hrvatske. Naši dobavljači osiguravaju servis prema zakonima RH. Kontakt za reklamacije je
linea@linea.hr
Plaćanje
Vaše naručene artikle možete platiti na nekoliko načina:
Pouzećem – plaćate dostavnoj službi prilikom preuzimanja robe
Uplatnicom/virmanom – plaćate na navedeni žiro račun Linea studia prema izdanom predračunu

Račun će vam biti izdan s datumom izlaska s našeg skladišta i bit će vam poslan na e-mail adresu koju ste dostavili prilikom registracije. Ukoliko želite da vam račun pošaljemo na neku drugu adresu, molimo vas da nas o tome obavijstite prilikom same kupovine u polju „napomene“.
Dostava naručenih artikala

Naručeni artikli bit će isporučeni na vašu adresu u najkraćem mogućem roku a najkasnije u roku od 10 radnih dana za dobavljive artikle odnosno one artikle koji dobavljači imaju na zalihama. U redovnim uvjetima roba se dostavlja kupcu radnim danom, unutar 1 do 5 radna od dana narudžbe, na otoke po dostavnom redu dostavljača do maksimalnih 10 radnih dana. Ako procjenimo da će rok dostave biti veći od 5 radnih dana ili da je nemoguće više dostaviti traženi artikal, nakon provjere kod dobavljača bit ćete obaviješteni o tome putem e-mail adrese koju ste naveli prilikom registracije.

U mjestima gdje postoji organizirana dostava, Vaš će paket biti dostavljen izravno u Vaš dom. Tamo gdje dostava paketa nije organizirana, pošta ili tvrtka koja se bavi kurirskom uslugom će Vas obavijestiti o prispijeću pošiljke i Vaš ćete paket moći podići u roku prema rokovima dostavne službe. Linea studio ili ovlašteni dostavljač zadržava pravo da se prilikom isporuke robe zatraži identifikacija primatelja putem osobnog dokumenta te ukoliko se ne dobije ista Linea studio zadržava pravo da ne isporuči poslanu robu. Primatelj svojim potpisom na dostavnici ili sličnom dokumentu potvrđuje primitak robe.
Troškovi dostave za standardne pakete za područje RH i van RH se izračunavana upit.
Pravo na raskid ugovora
Svaki ugovor sklopljen sredstvom daljinske komunikacije potrošač može, ne navodeći za to razlog, raskinuti u roku od sedam dana.
U slučaju sklapanja ugovora o prodaji proizvoda, rok iz stavka 1. ovoga članka počinje teći od dana kada je potrošač primio proizvod.
Oblik raskida ugovora
Ugovor se raskida pisanom obaviješću o raskidu poslanom trgovcu.
Ugovor je raskinut u trenutku kada je trgovac primio obavijest o raskidu.
Smatra se da je ugovor raskinut na vrijeme, ako je obavijest o raskidu upućena unutar predviđenog roka navedenom prije.
Posljedice raskida ugovora
U slučaju raskida ugovora, potrošač je dužan o svom trošku vratiti proizvod trgovcu.
Potrošač ne odgovara za štetu koju je trgovac pretrpio zbog raskida ugovora.
Trgovac je dužan, u roku od 30 dana od dana primitka pisane obavijesti o raskidu, vratiti potrošaču cjelokupan iznos koji je potrošač do trenutka raskida platio na temelju ugovora.
Isključenje prava na raskid ugovora
Osim ako stranke nisu drukčije ugovorile, potrošač nema pravo na raskid na temelju prethodnih članaka ako je riječ o ugovoru:
o prodaji proizvoda čija je cijena ovisna o fluktuacijama na financijskom tržištu,

o prodaji proizvoda izrađenog na temelju potrošačeve specifikacije, proizvoda izrađenog isključivo za potrošača ili proizvoda koji zbog svoje naravi ne može biti vraćen ili je podložan brzom propadanju
Pitanja

linea@linea.hr

Linea studio zadržava pravo trenutno s popisa korisnika brisati one korisnike koji bi kršili ova pravila i uvjete ili na neki drugi način usporavali ili ometali rad stranica te poduzeti odgovarajuće mjere protiv takvih korisnika. Linea studio ne odgovara za bilo kakvu štetu koja bi mogla nastati radi prekida dostupnosti, neobjavljivanja, odnosno brisanja oglasa ili grešaka u djelovanju web stranica. content.text: A new investment in cutting-edge technology – expanding capacity and capabilities
Two HP Stitch sublimation printers recently arrived at our production facility –
HP Stitch S1000 (3.2 m)
and
HP Stitch S500 (1.6 m)
– alongside which we also invested in a
Klieverik calender 3.2 m wide
. This significant investment opens the door to an even wider range of products and services.

The new HP Stitch printers enable us to achieve outstanding quality, greater speed and significantly higher production capacity. Thanks to them we can print on a variety of materials – from sports jerseys and fashion fabrics to interior textiles such as curtains. The industrial
HP Stitch S1000
will focus on large volumes, while the
HP Stitch S500
will take on smaller and specialised orders, ensuring continuity and flexibility in our work.
By installing the
Klieverik calender

we have further improved the print-fixing process – with a capacity of 400 m²/h, a stable temperature and low energy consumption. This has made our production faster, more efficient and adapted to greater market demands.

With the support of our long-standing partner Fortuna Digital, we are confident that this equipment will significantly enhance our work and provide our clients with products of even higher quality and greater variety.

Zaštita podataka

Zaštita vaših osobnih podataka regulirana je Zakonom o zaštiti osobnih podataka. Vaše osobne podatke koje dajete dobrovoljno pohraniti ćemo u našoj evidenciji. Vaše osobne podatke prikupljamo i koristimo u svrhu obrade narudžbe, za unaprjeđenje odnosa sa registriranim korisnicima te radi provjere i autorizacije prilikom plaćanja kreditnom karticom.

Registracijom na našim internet stranicama dajete Vašu suglasnost za obradu Vaših podataka u navedene svrhe. U svakom trenutku imate pravo zatražiti ispravak, izmjenu ili nadopunu netočnih, nepotpunih ili neažuriranih podataka, a ukoliko više ne želite primati naše newslettere ili promocijske ponude dovoljno je da se odjavite sa tih usluga.

Linea studio se obavezuje pružati zaštitu osobnim podacima kupaca, na način da prikuplja samo nužne, osnovne podatke o kupcima/ korisnicima koji su nužni za ispunjenje naših obveza; informira kupce o načinu korištenja prikupljenih podataka, redovito daje kupcima mogućnost izbora o upotrebi njihovih podataka, uključujući mogućnost odluke žele li ili ne da se njihovo ime ukloni s lista koje se koriste. Svi se podaci o korisnicima strogo čuvaju i dostupni su samo djelatnicima kojima su ti podaci nužni za obavljanje posla. Svi djelatnici Linea studio i poslovni partneri odgovorni su za poštivanje načela zaštite privatnosti.

šalje automatski po uspješno završenom procesu narudžbe tj. naplate

Uvid u vaše osobne podatke i povjest vaših završenih narudžbi možete dobiti prijavom u vaš korisnički račun putem vašeg e-maila i vaše lozinke. Korištenje kolačića
Web stranice
www.linea.hr

koriste tzv. kolačiće (eng. "cookies") kako bi se korisniku mogla besplatno pružiti usluga s potpunim funkcionalnostima i što kvalitetnijim sadržajem. Kolačići predstavljaju skup podataka koje generira poslužitelj web stranica i koje web preglednik sprema na disk korisnika u obliku male tekstualne datoteke s određenim podacima korisnika.
Vrste kolačića
Web stranica
www.linea.hr
koristi sljedeće kolačiće:
Privremeni kolačići (Session cookies) - postavljaju se na računalo korisnika web stranica
www.linea.hr
samo za vrijeme trajanja njegovog posjeta ovim web stranicama te se korisniku na taj način omogućuje da se učinkovitije služi web stranicama
www.linea.hr

Stalni kolačići (Persistent cookies) - riječ je o kolačićima koji će ostati "zabilježeni" u korisnikovom internetskom pregledniku dok ne isteknu ili on sam ručno ne izbriše. Prikupljene informacije su anonimne, a ne uključuju korisnikove osobne podatke.
Zašto dozvoliti upotrebu kolačića?
Linea studio koristi kolačiće:
radi pružanja boljeg korisničkog iskustva;
za praćenje i analizu korištenja i posjećenosti naših web-mjesta;
za ispravan rad stranica (u slučajevima kada je to neophodno).
Korisnik web stranica
www.linea.hr

uvijek može samostalno regulirati primanje kolačića putem postavki svojeg web preglednika. Linea studio isključuje svaku odgovornost za bilo kakav gubitak funkcionalnosti i/ili kvalitete sadržaja web stranica
www.linea.hr
u svim slučajevima odabira regulacije primanja kolačića od strane korisnika.

Linea studio nije odgovorna za kolačiće drugih internetskih stranica koje nisu u vlasništvu Linea studia. Informacije o korisniku dobivene kolačićima Linea studia će povezivati s drugim podacima o korisniku radi boljeg upoznavanja potreba korisnika i pružanja boljeg korisničkog iskustva, samo na temelju privole dobivene od korisnika.
Što ako korisnik ne prihvati kolačiće?

Ako korisnik ne prihvatiti kolačiće, moguće je da se određene značajke ove internetske stranice neće prikazivati ili ispravno raditi. To će korisniku ograničiti mogućnosti koje mu pruža stranica Linea studio te bi moglo utjecati na dizajn i korisničko iskustvo.
Kako možete upravljati kolačićima
U Vašim internet preglednicima možete brisati kolačiće i upravljati općim postavkama spremanja kolačića, ovdje poveznice na upute popularnih preglednika Firefox, Chrome, Safari.
Brisanje i upravljanje u postavkama preglednika

Većina web preglednika omogućava potpunu zabranu kolačića ili zabranu kolačića trećih strana. Ako u vašem pregledniku zabranite sve kolačiće, mnoge stranice koje posjetite na internetu neće adekvatno funkcionirati pa tako ni naše.

Korištenjem web stranica
www.linea.hr
smatra se da je korisnik u svakom trenutku upoznat s ovim uvjetima korištenja, uključujući s odredbama o obradi podataka i mogućnostima u vezi s kolačićima.
Linea studio zadržava pravo izmjene sadržaja ovih web stranica te neće biti odgovorna ni za kakve moguće posljedice proizašle iz takvih promjena.
Protection of the privacy of personal data
Data protection

The protection of your personal data is regulated by the Personal Data Protection Act. The personal data you provide voluntarily will be stored in our records. We collect and use your personal data for the purpose of processing orders, for improving relations with registered users, and for verification and authorisation during credit card payments.

By registering on our website you give your consent to the processing of your data for the stated purposes. At any time you have the right to request the correction, modification or supplementing of inaccurate, incomplete or out-of-date data, and if you no longer wish to receive our newsletters or promotional offers it is sufficient to unsubscribe from those services.

Linea studio undertakes to protect the personal data of customers by collecting only the necessary, basic data about customers/users that is essential for fulfilling our obligations; informing customers about how the collected data is used; regularly giving customers a choice about the use of their data, including the option to decide whether or not they want their name removed from the lists used. All user data is strictly safeguarded and accessible only to staff for whom this data is essential to perform their work. All Linea studio staff and business partners are responsible for respecting the principles of privacy protection.
Data we collect for the purposes of online shopping
In order to use the online ordering and product purchasing service in the online store
www.linea.hr
, we need certain personal data:
Your email, with which we identify you as a user, i.e. enable access to your user profile
Your first and last name, which we use to personalise system messages and the email messages that the website
www.linea.hr
sends automatically upon the successful completion of the order, i.e. payment, process
Address details used for delivery

For sole traders and companies, the OIB (personal identification number) and company name are also used as an integral part of the invoicing process, if you request an R1 invoice • A telephone number used solely to contact you in the event of a problem with the fulfilment of your order

A contact email (which may differ from your user email) is used solely so that, after the successful completion of the order, i.e. online payment, process, an email can be sent to your contact email confirming that we have received your order, i.e. payment.
These data are stored in your user profile on the website
www.linea.hr
, together with a history of your orders, and access to these data is available only to you as the user, and
www.linea.hr
as the service provider. If online payment is selected, your personal data are also forwarded to the WsPay online payment system.

You can access your personal data and the history of your completed orders by logging into your user account using your email and password. In your user profile you can also update your personal data. All data can be updated except for the account email, which is the identifier of the user profile and cannot be changed.
If you wish to exercise your "right to be forgotten", send an email to
linea@linea.hr

stating that you wish to delete your user account, and we will ensure that your personal data are deleted from our system as quickly as possible and are no longer used in our data processing operations, with the note that we cannot delete data from invoices already issued, i.e. online payments and the offline archive.
Data we collect via the contact form
In order to help you resolve any problems and queries, we need some of your personal data:
First and last name
A contact email at which we can reach you
and optionally a telephone number if you would like us to contact you by phone
These data are sent exclusively to the email
linea@linea.hr
and are not stored on the website
linea.hr
Newsletter sign-ups
If you wish to receive the Linea studio newsletter, you can sign up via the newsletter form. At any time you can choose the "unsubscribe" option if you no longer wish to receive our newsletter.
Use of cookies
The website
www.linea.hr

uses so-called cookies in order to provide the user, free of charge, with a service offering full functionality and the highest possible quality of content. Cookies are a set of data generated by the website server and stored by the web browser on the user's disk in the form of a small text file containing certain user data.
Types of cookies
The website
www.linea.hr
uses the following cookies:
Session cookies - these are placed on the computer of the user of the website
www.linea.hr
only for the duration of their visit to this website, thereby enabling the user to make more efficient use of the website
www.linea.hr

Persistent cookies - these are cookies that will remain "stored" in the user's web browser until they expire or the user manually deletes them. The information collected is anonymous and does not include the user's personal data.
Why allow the use of cookies?
Linea studio uses cookies:
to provide a better user experience;
to monitor and analyse the use and traffic of our websites;
for the correct functioning of the site (in cases where this is essential).
The user of the website
www.linea.hr

can always regulate the receipt of cookies independently via the settings of their web browser. Linea studio excludes any liability for any loss of functionality and/or quality of the content of the website
www.linea.hr
in all cases where the user chooses to regulate the receipt of cookies.

Linea studio is not responsible for the cookies of other websites that are not owned by Linea studio. Information about the user obtained through Linea studio's cookies will be linked with other data about the user in order to better understand the user's needs and provide a better user experience, only on the basis of consent obtained from the user.
What if the user does not accept cookies?

If the user does not accept cookies, certain features of this website may not display or work correctly. This will limit the options that the Linea studio website offers the user and could affect the design and user experience.
How you can manage cookies
In your web browsers you can delete cookies and manage the general settings for storing cookies; here are links to the instructions for the popular browsers Firefox, Chrome, Safari.
Deleting and managing in browser settings

Most web browsers allow cookies to be completely blocked or third-party cookies to be blocked. If you block all cookies in your browser, many of the sites you visit on the internet will not function adequately, including ours.
Website statistics
In addition, the website
www.linea.hr

tracks visitor statistics solely in order to obtain the necessary information about the appeal and success of its pages on the market, using a third-party service called Google Analytics. Detailed third-party information about this service, as well as about the options available to users of the website
www.linea.hr
regarding the regulation of the cookies necessary for it, are available at:
http://www.google.com/intl/en/analytics/privacyoverview.html
Other
By using the website
www.linea.hr
the user is deemed to be aware at all times of these terms of use, including the provisions on data processing and the options relating to cookies.
Linea studio reserves the right to change the content of this website and will not be liable for any possible consequences arising from such changes.

content.text: Terms of business (general)
The website
www.linea.hr

is owned by the business Linea studio za dizajn i tisak (hereinafter Linea studio). These terms of business apply to registered users. Any adult person who is fully legally competent and who accepts Linea studio's terms of business may become a registered user (hereinafter the user or registered user). On first sign-up it is necessary to register and to fill in all required fields with truthful data. The customer confirms acceptance of the general terms of business by registering. We reserve the right to change the terms of use of this website at any time.

Changes take effect at the moment of publication. The registered user is obliged to read the rules and terms of use regularly, and by accessing the website is deemed to be aware of the current rules and terms of use, which they also confirm when confirming a purchase.
Purchasing on the website

Every registered user may purchase items from Linea studio's range displayed on the website. The sales contract between the registered user and Linea studio becomes valid upon receipt of the ordered shipment and applies exclusively to the territory of Croatia.
Prices

All stated prices exclude VAT and are expressed in kuna. Offers and prices for special promotions are valid until the expiry of the deadline stated on the website itself or while stocks last. The price does not include shipping costs, which will be stated separately when ordering items. Shipping costs may be increased by additional costs that may arise during delivery, in accordance with the terms of the delivery service providing that service.
Warranty and service

The warranty period is stated for each individual item. For items for which no warranty period is stated, the periods of the general warranty terms under the applicable laws of the Republic of Croatia apply. Our suppliers provide service in accordance with Croatian law. The contact for complaints is
linea@linea.hr
Payment
You can pay for your ordered items in several ways:
Cash on delivery – you pay the delivery service upon receiving the goods
By payment slip/bank transfer – you pay into the stated Linea studio giro account according to the issued proforma invoice

The invoice will be issued with the date the goods leave our warehouse and will be sent to the email address you provided on registration. If you would like us to send the invoice to a different address, please notify us during the purchase itself in the „notes“ field.
Delivery of ordered items

Ordered items will be delivered to your address in the shortest possible time, and no later than within 10 working days for available items, i.e. those items the suppliers have in stock. Under normal conditions, goods are delivered to the customer on working days, within 1 to 5 working days from the date of the order; to the islands according to the carrier's delivery schedule, up to a maximum of 10 working days. If we estimate that the delivery period will exceed 5 working days or that it is no longer possible to deliver the requested item, you will be informed of this, after checking with the supplier, via the email address you provided on registration.

In places where organised delivery exists, your parcel will be delivered directly to your home. Where parcel delivery is not organised, the post office or the courier company will notify you of the arrival of the shipment and you will be able to collect your parcel within the periods set by the delivery service. Linea studio or the authorised carrier reserves the right to request identification of the recipient by means of a personal document upon delivery of the goods, and if this is not provided, Linea studio reserves the right not to deliver the dispatched goods. By signing the delivery note or a similar document, the recipient confirms receipt of the goods.
Delivery costs for standard parcels within and outside the Republic of Croatia are calculated on request.
Right to terminate the contract
The consumer may terminate any contract concluded by means of distance communication, without stating a reason, within seven days.
In the case of a contract for the sale of a product, the period referred to in paragraph 1 of this article begins on the day the consumer received the product.
Form of contract termination
The contract is terminated by written notice of termination sent to the trader.
The contract is terminated at the moment the trader receives the notice of termination.
The contract is deemed to have been terminated on time if the notice of termination was sent within the period specified above.
Consequences of contract termination
In the event of contract termination, the consumer is obliged to return the product to the trader at their own expense.
The consumer is not liable for any damage the trader has suffered as a result of the contract termination.
Within 30 days of receiving the written notice of termination, the trader is obliged to return to the consumer the entire amount the consumer paid under the contract up to the moment of termination.
Exclusion of the right to terminate the contract
Unless the parties have agreed otherwise, the consumer has no right of termination under the preceding articles where the contract concerns:
the sale of a product whose price depends on fluctuations in the financial market,
the sale of a product made to the consumer's specification, a product made exclusively for the consumer, or a product which by its nature cannot be returned or is liable to deteriorate rapidly
Questions
You can also send your questions, suggestions and compliments by email:
linea@linea.hr
Additional notes

Linea studio reserves the right to immediately delete from the list of users those users who breach these rules and terms or in any other way slow down or interfere with the operation of the website, and to take appropriate measures against such users. Linea studio is not liable for any damage that may arise due to an interruption of availability, non-publication or deletion of a listing, or errors in the operation of the website. content.text: The tent can often be seen at open-air concerts, fairs and other large public events. The cover is attached to the frames with Velcro ® straps sewn into each of the four corners.
A travel bag and pegs for additional fastening into the ground in case of wind are included.
The tent can often be seen at open-air concerts, fairs and other large public events.
The cover is attached to the frames with Velcro ® straps sewn into each of the four corners.
A travel bag and pegs for additional fastening into the ground in case of wind are included.
The tent consists of hard steel tubes and rough polyester fabric so that it lasts as long as possible.
Overprinting on the existing fabric or printing of a complete new cover and side panels is possible.
Teleios Grande H6
The large-format textile printer is used for printing on polyester materials, mainly flags, textile banners, interior-decoration materials, or for various presentation systems.
It offers a wide range of colours and high saturation. Printing on textile is becoming increasingly popular due to its low weight, simple transport and installation.
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h.
Thermal transfer film
Thermal transfer film is the printing of personalised simpler vector graphics, lettering, jersey numbers, crests, logos, etc.
The graphic is cut on film cutters; after that the excess film is removed, and finally on the adhesive transfer your graphic remains mirror-cut and ready for application with a heat press.
HP Stitch S1000

The large-format sublimation textile printer is intended for professional production of printing on polyester materials. It is ideal for making flags, textile banners, interior-decoration graphics and various promotional and exhibition systems.
The HP Stitch S1000 offers an exceptionally wide colour range and high saturation, with precise colour management thanks to HP's advanced calibration technology.
We are able to print at a maximum width of up to 320 cm, at a speed of up to 220 m²/h, with top quality and colour fastness.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

content.text: Šator se često može vidjeti na otvorenim koncertima, sajmovima, i ostalih velikim javnim događanjima.
Pokrov je pričvršen na okvire s Velcro ® trakama, koje su ušivene u svakom od četiri kuta.
Uključena je putna torba i klinovi za dodatno pričvrščenje u zemlju u slučaju vjetra.
Šator se sastoji od tvrdih čeličnih cijevi i grubog poliesterskog platna kako bi što duže trajao.
Moguć je dotisak na postojeće platno ili print kompletnog novog pokrova i bočnih stranica.
Teleios Grande H6

Tekstilni printer velikog formata koristi se za tiskanje na poliesterskim materijalima, uglavnom zastavama, tekstilnim bannerima, materijalima za unutarnje uređenje, ili za razne prezentacijske sustave.
Nudi širok raspon boja i veliku zasićenost. Tisak na tekstilu postaju sve popularniji zbog svoje male težine, jednostavnog transporta i instalacije.
U mogućnosti smo izraditi tisak maksimalne širine 320cm brzinom od 177m2/h.
Termo transfer folija
Termo transfer folija je tisak personaliziranih jednostavnijih vektroskih grafika, natpisa, brojeva za dresove, grbova, logotipa, i sl.

Grafika se izrezuje na rezačima folija (cutterima) nakon toga se odstranjuje višak folije te na kraju na ljepljivom transferu ostaje vaša grafika zrcalno izrezana i spremna za apliciranje sa termo prešom.
HP Stitch S1000

Sublimacijski tekstilni printer velikog formata namijenjen je profesionalnoj produkciji tiska na poliesterskim materijalima. Idealan je za izradu zastava, tekstilnih bannera, grafika za unutarnje uređenje te raznih promotivnih i izložbenih sustava.
HP Stitch S1000 nudi iznimno širok raspon boja i visoku zasićenost, uz precizno upravljanje bojom zahvaljujući HP-ovoj naprednoj tehnologiji kalibracije.
U mogućnosti smo izraditi tisak maksimalne širine do 320 cm, brzinom do 220 m²/h, uz vrhunsku kvalitetu i postojanost boja.
Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

The oval promo table is assembled very simply and quickly with Velcro tape, and as such is an ideal and very cheap means of promotion as a sales kiosk, promotional table, demonstration stand, etc. The top is an imitation of white wood.

Mimaki UJV 55-320
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h. The Mimaki UJV55-320 is a large-format printer with a maximum print width of 320cm.

It enables high imprint quality, fast printing and cost-effectiveness, and the main advantage of the UV printer is that there is no need to laminate the imprint for protection. We use the UV printer most often for making graphics for presentation systems, banners and stickers.
Seiko H-104s

The Seiko H-104s is a mild-solvent ink-jet printer designed to deliver top performance at a low printing cost. Solvent printing is characterised by imprint durability, resistance to outdoor conditions (rain, sun, wind) and resistance to mechanical damage (scratching).

It is used in making Jumbo posters, PVC stickers, backlit and frontlit banners, posters, window graphics. The downside of solvent printing is the smell. It takes a few days for the print to dry and for the smell to disappear completely, so it is not ideal for indoor spaces.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).
If you are not sure how our presentation systems are assembled, feel free to contact us and we will be glad to help with our advice.

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.

Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

hr.name: Roll-Up Classic

content.text: Roll-up je idealan za prezentaciju na raznim prigodama zbog svoje lake i jednostavne montaže, te jednostavnog transporta. Ovaj stalak najbolji je izbor za klijente koji očekuju visoko kvalitetan proizvod i uvijek zaštićenu grafiku prilikom transporta. Montaža je vrlo jednostavna i brza, potrebno je samo izvući grafiku i baze i prikavačiti ju na potpornu šipku. Sjajnu stabilnost omogućuju dvije nogice koje se postavljaju rotiranjem za 90°.
Roll-up Classic je dostupan u dimenzijama 85x200, 100x200 i 120x200cm.
Pakiranje:
aluminijski stalak
transportna torba s dodatnim ojačanjem
kartonska kutija
Mimaki UJV 55-320
U mogućnosti smo izraditi tisak maksimalne širine 320cm brzinom od 177m2/h. Mimaki UJV55-320 je printer velikog formata maksimalne širine ispisa 320cm.

Omogućuje visoku kvalitetu otiska, brzi ispis te ekonomičnost, a glavna prednost UV printera je ta što nije potrebno laminirati otisak radi zaštite. UV printer koristimo najčešće za izradu grafika prezentacijskih sustava, banner te naljepnica.
Seiko H-104s

Seiko H-104s je mild solventni ink-jet printer dizajniran da pruži vrhunske performance uz nisku cijenu ispisa. Solvent tisak karakterizira trajnost ispisa, otpornost na vanjske uvjete (kiša, sunce, vjetar) te otpornost na mehanička oštećenja (grebanje).

Koristi se u izradi Jumbo plakata, PVC naljepnica, backlit i frontlit bannera, plakata, prozorske grafike. Negativna strana solventnog tiska je miris. Potrebno nekoliko dana se print osuši te da miris u potpunosti nestane, pa stoga nije idealan za unutarnje prostore.

roll_up_200.pdf
roll_up_250.pdf
Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

Kod crnih ploha, 100% crna boja nije dovoljna da bi dobili jaču i tamniju crnu boju. Za punoću crne boje koristite CMYK boju koji se sastoji od: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. Ovo ne vrijedi za datoteke namijenjene za print na tekstil, odnosno sublimacijom, tada mora biti crna C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

Za izradu verlauf (prijelaz, gradijent) preporučujemo da ga napravite unutar Photoshop-a jer vektorski generirani gradijenti imaju problema prilikom RIP-anja i često dolazi do pojave “stepenica” u rasponu gradijenta (kako bi bili potpuno sigurni da smo izbjegli mogućnost stepenica dobro je napraviti "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) na gradijentu).
Veličina, napusti i margine datoteke
Datoteke kreirajte u njihovoj stvarnoj konačnoj dimenziji sa napustima.
Povećanje manjeg formata datoteke na veći format može dovesti do smanjenja kvalitete razlučivosti. Na primjer, povećanje A6 letka na letak A4, može utjecati na kvalitetu vašeg konačog proizvoda.

Uvijek dodajte napust (bleed) na konačnu dimenziju datoteke jer ćete time olakšati kod rezanja na format i neće se pojavljivati bijeli obrub Napust neka iznosi 3mm preko ruba završenog formata osim ako nije drugačije definirano u uputi za grafičku priprema za taj proizvod.
Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.
Slike, grafike, tekst i linije
Svi rasterski elementi grafičke pripreme trebali bi biti oko:
30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),
60 do 100 dpi za formate A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 (plakati, posteri, pultevi, roll upovi, banneri…),
100 do 150 dpi za format A3 (manji plakati, slike…),
200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.
Linije trebaju biti debljine barem 0.125 pt
Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke
Preferiramo dostavu dokumenata u pdf ili tif formatu. Prihvaćamo i slijedeće formate datoteka za digitalni tisak: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Uz datoteku s grafičkom pripremom, molimo pošaljite i preview niže rezolucije (.jpg).

content.text: Shirts are the most widespread and most popular promotional article, whether it is a classic T-shirt, an elegant polo or a sports shirt, it is a garment with which you can never go wrong.
We offer a wide selection of shirts to satisfy all customers' wishes (men's or women's, fitted or classic, a wide palette of colours, sleeve lengths…)
Printing on shirts is most often done using screen printing.
It is possible to print on shirts in one or more colours, on almost all types of shirts, polo shirts or other types and weights of shirts.
In addition to screen printing, we can also offer machine embroidery (stitch) or direct printing on textile.
Screen printing

Screen printing is the oldest printing technique with a wide application, especially for finished advertising or printed products. It is used for printing on various materials, e.g. printing on textile, metal, PVC substrates, ceramics, rubber or various promotional articles.
Screen printing is distinguished by a long imprint lifespan in all conditions of use and high coverage, so that a quality screen print has many years of use without damage.
Machine embroidery or stitch
Machine embroidery or stitch is distinguished by excellent quality and durability, a wide choice of thread colours of high strength and colourfastness.
Machine embroidery is suitable for application to various types of textile materials, especially materials that cannot withstand thermal application.

hr.name: Majice dugih rukava

content.text: Tisak na majice se najčešće izrađuje tehnikom sitotiska.
Moguće je tiskati na majice u jednoj ili više boja, na skoro sve vrste majica, polo majica ili nekih drugih vrsta i gramatura majica.
Osim sitotiska, možemo ponuditi i strojni vez (štik) ili direktni tisak na tekstil.
Sitotisak

Sitotisak je najstarija tehnika tiska koja ima široku primjenu, posebno kod gotovih reklamnih ili tiskanih proizvoda.
Koristi za tisak na razne materijale kao npr. tisak na tekstil, metal, PVC podloge, keramiku, gumu ili različite promotivne artikle.
Sitotisak odlikuje dugi vijek trajanja otiska u svim uvjetima korištenja i velika pokrivnost, tako da kvalitetno izvedene tisak u sitotisku ima višegodišnju upotrebu bez oštećenja.
Strojni vez ili štik
Strojni vez ili štik se odlikuje odličnom kvalitetom i trajnošću, veliki izbor boja konca visoke čvrstoće i postojanosti.
Strojni vez je pogodan za apliciranje na razne vrste tekstilnih materijala, specijalno na materijale koji ne podnose termo apliciranje.

U ponudi imamo široki izbor majica kako bi zadovoljili sve želje kupaca (muške ili ženske, strukirane ili klasične, široka paleta boja, dužina rukava…)

content.text: The Roll-up Exclusive is an elegant solution for presenting your company, products and services. The Roll-up Exclusive is a model with a sturdy construction and is therefore the most durable and elegant. The Roll-up is ideal for presentation at various occasions due to its easy and simple assembly and simple transport.
This stand is the best choice for clients who expect a high-quality product and graphics that are always protected during transport.

The Roll-up is ideal for presentation at various occasions due to its easy and simple assembly and simple transport. This stand is the best choice for clients who expect a high-quality product and graphics that are always protected during transport. Assembly is very simple and fast; you just need to pull out the graphic and base and clip it onto the support pole. Excellent stability is provided by two legs that are set by rotating 90°.
Roll-up Exclusive is available in dimensions 100x200cm
Packaging:
aluminium stand
transport bag with additional reinforcement
cardboard box
Mimaki UJV 55-320
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h. The Mimaki UJV55-320 is a large-format printer with a maximum print width of 320cm.

It enables high imprint quality, fast printing and cost-effectiveness, and the main advantage of the UV printer is that there is no need to laminate the imprint for protection. We use the UV printer most often for making graphics for presentation systems, banners and stickers.
Seiko H-104s

The Seiko H-104s is a mild-solvent ink-jet printer designed to deliver top performance at a low printing cost. Solvent printing is characterised by imprint durability, resistance to outdoor conditions (rain, sun, wind) and resistance to mechanical damage (scratching).

It is used in making Jumbo posters, PVC stickers, backlit and frontlit banners, posters, window graphics. The downside of solvent printing is the smell. It takes a few days for the print to dry and for the smell to disappear completely, so it is not ideal for indoor spaces.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).
If you are not sure how our presentation systems are assembled, feel free to contact us and we will be glad to help with our advice.

content.text: The freestanding stand for disinfectant is assembled easily and quickly by gluing with double-sided tape to an aluminium profile, which is then connected to a sturdy base.
The stand consists of a PVC bottle 500ml with a pump set into a plexiglass frame 3mm thick, and the bottle cannot be removed from the frame.
Overprinting on the stand as desired; for larger quantities a change of plexiglass colour is possible.
Print size: 87x154 mm
The price includes the first fill of alcohol-based ALCOSAN disinfectant
- material plexi 3mm
- PVC bottle 500ml with pump
- UV print
- first fill of alcohol-based ALCOSAN disinfectant

When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).

Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.

200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.

Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke

content.text: We offer a wide range of work and fashion jackets for all purposes and weather conditions.
The most popular are jackets and vests made of Polar Fleece and SoftShell materials.
We offer a wide range of work and fashion jackets for all purposes and weather conditions.
The most popular are jackets and vests made of Polar Fleece and SoftShell materials.
Softshell is a laminated textile that is waterproof while at the same time breathable.
Such clothing is lightweight, stretchy, warm and has high mechanical resistance.
Screen printing

Screen printing is the oldest printing technique with a wide application, especially for finished advertising or printed products. It is used for printing on various materials, e.g. printing on textile, metal, PVC substrates, ceramics, rubber or various promotional articles.
Screen printing is distinguished by a long imprint lifespan in all conditions of use and high coverage, so that a quality screen print has many years of use without damage.
Machine embroidery or stitch
Machine embroidery or stitch is distinguished by excellent quality and durability, a wide choice of thread colours of high strength and colourfastness.
Machine embroidery is suitable for application to various types of textile materials, especially materials that cannot withstand thermal application.
Thermal transfer film
Thermal transfer film is the printing of personalised simpler vector graphics, lettering, jersey numbers, crests, logos, etc.
The graphic is cut on film cutters; after that the excess film is removed, and finally on the adhesive transfer your graphic remains mirror-cut and ready for application with a heat press.

content.text: U ponudi imamo širok asortiman radnih i modnih jakni za sve namjene i vremenske uvjete.
Najpopularnije su jakne i prsluci od Polar Flis i SoftShell materijala.
Softshell je lamninirani tekstil koji je vodootporan a istovremeno propustan na zrak.
Takva odjeća je lagana, rastezljiva, topla i ima veliku mehaničku otpornost.
Sitotisak

Sitotisak je najstarija tehnika tiska koja ima široku primjenu, posebno kod gotovih reklamnih ili tiskanih proizvoda.
Koristi za tisak na razne materijale kao npr. tisak na tekstil, metal, PVC podloge, keramiku, gumu ili različite promotivne artikle.
Sitotisak odlikuje dugi vijek trajanja otiska u svim uvjetima korištenja i velika pokrivnost, tako da kvalitetno izvedene tisak u sitotisku ima višegodišnju upotrebu bez oštećenja.
Strojni vez ili štik
Strojni vez ili štik se odlikuje odličnom kvalitetom i trajnošću, veliki izbor boja konca visoke čvrstoće i postojanosti.
Strojni vez je pogodan za apliciranje na razne vrste tekstilnih materijala, specijalno na materijale koji ne podnose termo apliciranje.
Termo transfer folija
Termo transfer folija je tisak personaliziranih jednostavnijih vektroskih grafika, natpisa, brojeva za dresove, grbova, logotipa, i sl.

Grafika se izrezuje na rezačima folija (cutterima) nakon toga se odstranjuje višak folije te na kraju na ljepljivom transferu ostaje vaša grafika zrcalno izrezana i spremna za apliciranje sa termo prešom.

The large-format textile printer is used for printing on polyester materials, mainly flags, textile banners, interior-decoration materials, or for various presentation systems.

The large-format sublimation textile printer is intended for professional production of printing on polyester materials. It is ideal for making flags, textile banners, interior-decoration graphics and various promotional and exhibition systems.
The HP Stitch S1000 offers an exceptionally wide colour range and high saturation, with precise colour management thanks to HP's advanced calibration technology.
We are able to print at a maximum width of up to 320 cm, at a speed of up to 220 m²/h, with top quality and colour fastness.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

content.text: Floor graphics are made with digital print on special PVC film and additionally protected from mechanical damage with anti-slip lamination.

Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).

Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.

Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
