content.text: The Pano Desk is intended for indoor use. It is ideal as a sales kiosk, promotional table, demonstration stand, etc. It is assembled very simply and quickly. Due to its heavy construction, the Pano Desk is a very firm and stable promo table that will last for many years.

The Pano Desk is intended for indoor use. It is ideal as a sales kiosk, promotional table, demonstration stand, etc. It is assembled very simply and quickly. Due to its heavy construction, the Pano Desk is a very firm and stable promo table that will last for many years.
Graphic dimensions: (34x79x34) x 93 cm
Box dimensions: 105x87x10 cm
Weight: 16 kg
Mimaki UJV 55-320
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h. The Mimaki UJV55-320 is a large-format printer with a maximum print width of 320cm.

It enables high imprint quality, fast printing and cost-effectiveness, and the main advantage of the UV printer is that there is no need to laminate the imprint for protection. We use the UV printer most often for making graphics for presentation systems, banners and stickers.
Seiko H-104s

The Seiko H-104s is a mild-solvent ink-jet printer designed to deliver top performance at a low printing cost. Solvent printing is characterised by imprint durability, resistance to outdoor conditions (rain, sun, wind) and resistance to mechanical damage (scratching).

It is used in making Jumbo posters, PVC stickers, backlit and frontlit banners, posters, window graphics. The downside of solvent printing is the smell. It takes a few days for the print to dry and for the smell to disappear completely, so it is not ideal for indoor spaces.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).
If you are not sure how our presentation systems are assembled, feel free to contact us and we will be glad to help with our advice.

Mimaki UJV 55-320
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h. The Mimaki UJV55-320 is a large-format printer with a maximum print width of 320cm.

It enables high imprint quality, fast printing and cost-effectiveness, and the main advantage of the UV printer is that there is no need to laminate the imprint for protection. We use the UV printer most often for making graphics for presentation systems, banners and stickers.
Seiko H-104s

The Seiko H-104s is a mild-solvent ink-jet printer designed to deliver top performance at a low printing cost. Solvent printing is characterised by imprint durability, resistance to outdoor conditions (rain, sun, wind) and resistance to mechanical damage (scratching).

It is used in making Jumbo posters, PVC stickers, backlit and frontlit banners, posters, window graphics. The downside of solvent printing is the smell. It takes a few days for the print to dry and for the smell to disappear completely, so it is not ideal for indoor spaces.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).
If you are not sure how our presentation systems are assembled, feel free to contact us and we will be glad to help with our advice.

Mimaki UJV 55-320
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h. The Mimaki UJV55-320 is a large-format printer with a maximum print width of 320cm.

It enables high imprint quality, fast printing and cost-effectiveness, and the main advantage of the UV printer is that there is no need to laminate the imprint for protection. We use the UV printer most often for making graphics for presentation systems, banners and stickers.
Seiko H-104s

The Seiko H-104s is a mild-solvent ink-jet printer designed to deliver top performance at a low printing cost. Solvent printing is characterised by imprint durability, resistance to outdoor conditions (rain, sun, wind) and resistance to mechanical damage (scratching).

It is used in making Jumbo posters, PVC stickers, backlit and frontlit banners, posters, window graphics. The downside of solvent printing is the smell. It takes a few days for the print to dry and for the smell to disappear completely, so it is not ideal for indoor spaces.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).
If you are not sure how our presentation systems are assembled, feel free to contact us and we will be glad to help with our advice.

Seiko H-104s

Seiko H-104s je mild solventni ink-jet printer dizajniran da pruži vrhunske performance uz nisku cijenu ispisa. Solvent tisak karakterizira trajnost ispisa, otpornost na vanjske uvjete (kiša, sunce, vjetar) te otpornost na mehanička oštećenja (grebanje).

Koristi se u izradi Jumbo plakata, PVC naljepnica, backlit i frontlit bannera, plakata, prozorske grafike. Negativna strana solventnog tiska je miris. Potrebno nekoliko dana se print osuši te da miris u potpunosti nestane, pa stoga nije idealan za unutarnje prostore.

Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

Kod crnih ploha, 100% crna boja nije dovoljna da bi dobili jaču i tamniju crnu boju. Za punoću crne boje koristite CMYK boju koji se sastoji od: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. Ovo ne vrijedi za datoteke namijenjene za print na tekstil, odnosno sublimacijom, tada mora biti crna C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

Za izradu verlauf (prijelaz, gradijent) preporučujemo da ga napravite unutar Photoshop-a jer vektorski generirani gradijenti imaju problema prilikom RIP-anja i često dolazi do pojave “stepenica” u rasponu gradijenta (kako bi bili potpuno sigurni da smo izbjegli mogućnost stepenica dobro je napraviti "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) na gradijentu).
Veličina, napusti i margine datoteke
Datoteke kreirajte u njihovoj stvarnoj konačnoj dimenziji sa napustima.
Povećanje manjeg formata datoteke na veći format može dovesti do smanjenja kvalitete razlučivosti. Na primjer, povećanje A6 letka na letak A4, može utjecati na kvalitetu vašeg konačog proizvoda.

Uvijek dodajte napust (bleed) na konačnu dimenziju datoteke jer ćete time olakšati kod rezanja na format i neće se pojavljivati bijeli obrub Napust neka iznosi 3mm preko ruba završenog formata osim ako nije drugačije definirano u uputi za grafičku priprema za taj proizvod.
Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.
Slike, grafike, tekst i linije
Svi rasterski elementi grafičke pripreme trebali bi biti oko:
30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),
60 do 100 dpi za formate A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 (plakati, posteri, pultevi, roll upovi, banneri…),
100 do 150 dpi za format A3 (manji plakati, slike…),
200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.
Linije trebaju biti debljine barem 0.125 pt
Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke
Preferiramo dostavu dokumenata u pdf ili tif formatu. Prihvaćamo i slijedeće formate datoteka za digitalni tisak: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Uz datoteku s grafičkom pripremom, molimo pošaljite i preview niže rezolucije (.jpg).

This frame is not illuminated. PICUP frames can be joined using an additional connector that must be ordered separately.
Available dimensions: 85x200, 85x245, 100x200 and 100x245
Two graphics are required for the construction
Teleios Grande H6
The large-format textile printer is used for printing on polyester materials, mainly flags, textile banners, interior-decoration materials, or for various presentation systems.
It offers a wide range of colours and high saturation. Printing on textile is becoming increasingly popular due to its low weight, simple transport and installation.
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h.
Mimaki UJV 55-320
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h. The Mimaki UJV55-320 is a large-format printer with a maximum print width of 320cm.

It enables high imprint quality, fast printing and cost-effectiveness, and the main advantage of the UV printer is that there is no need to laminate the imprint for protection. We use the UV printer most often for making graphics for presentation systems, banners and stickers.
HP Stitch S1000

The large-format sublimation textile printer is intended for professional production of printing on polyester materials. It is ideal for making flags, textile banners, interior-decoration graphics and various promotional and exhibition systems.
The HP Stitch S1000 offers an exceptionally wide colour range and high saturation, with precise colour management thanks to HP's advanced calibration technology.
We are able to print at a maximum width of up to 320 cm, at a speed of up to 220 m²/h, with top quality and colour fastness.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).

Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.

Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.

30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),

200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).

Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Teleios Grande H6
The large-format textile printer is used for printing on polyester materials, mainly flags, textile banners, interior-decoration materials, or for various presentation systems.
It offers a wide range of colours and high saturation. Printing on textile is becoming increasingly popular due to its low weight, simple transport and installation.
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h.
HP Stitch S1000

The large-format sublimation textile printer is intended for professional production of printing on polyester materials. It is ideal for making flags, textile banners, interior-decoration graphics and various promotional and exhibition systems.
The HP Stitch S1000 offers an exceptionally wide colour range and high saturation, with precise colour management thanks to HP's advanced calibration technology.
We are able to print at a maximum width of up to 320 cm, at a speed of up to 220 m²/h, with top quality and colour fastness.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).
If you are not sure how our presentation systems are assembled, feel free to contact us and we will be glad to help

The large-format textile printer is used for printing on polyester materials, mainly flags, textile banners, interior-decoration materials, or for various presentation systems.
It offers a wide range of colours and high saturation. Printing on textile is becoming increasingly popular due to its low weight, simple transport and installation.
We are able to print at a maximum width of 320cm at a speed of 177m2/h.
HP Stitch S1000

The large-format sublimation textile printer is intended for professional production of printing on polyester materials. It is ideal for making flags, textile banners, interior-decoration graphics and various promotional and exhibition systems.
The HP Stitch S1000 offers an exceptionally wide colour range and high saturation, with precise colour management thanks to HP's advanced calibration technology.
We are able to print at a maximum width of up to 320 cm, at a speed of up to 220 m²/h, with top quality and colour fastness.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

en.name: Fixed flagpoles for flags

content.text: A flagpole is an excellent solution for any company yard.
All our flagpoles are equipped with sturdy, high-quality bases for easy installation and maintenance.
We offer polyester flagpoles 6, 8, 10 and 12 metres high with internal or external rope or with a winch.
We also offer a flagpole installation service.
The greatest advantages of our polyester flagpoles are:
- rust-free
- no earthing required
- easy to maintain
- offer a perfect price-to-quality ratio
The flagpole package includes:
- M20 anchors: 3 pieces with nuts and washers
- plate for mounting the flagpole
- rope
- flagpole finial (complete set)
- weight
- lock with key
Flagpole with external rope

Flagpoles with external rope are generally cheaper than those with internal rope. They are equipped with a durable plastic handle that serves to fix the rope at the desired height. The nylon rope we use is extremely durable and long-lasting.
Flagpole with internal rope

Flagpoles with internal rope are generally quieter and aesthetically nicer. They come with the option of a small door or the option of a winch. Both systems are very easy to use and can include a collar with a weight that will maintain the flag tension.
Flagpole with winch

The winch system is our most popular flagpole for public areas where there is a possibility of theft and vandalism. It is completely enclosed and controlled with a winch that can be removed after use. The system is extremely robust and durable.

content.text: A letterhead is used for making official documents, letters or invoices by a company.

It most often contains the company logo with general data such as address, telephone, fax, website, e-mail, and depending on the type of document, it may also contain giro account numbers, banks, etc.

The standard letterhead format is A4 (210 x 297 mm), but if it is a letterhead for special purposes it can also be in other formats, and the paper for printing letterheads is most often offset 80 or 90gr.
For larger numbers of pieces, offset printing is recommended, which achieves a high-quality imprint, while for smaller numbers digital printing is recommended.
Offset printing

Offset printing is a printing technique in which the print is transferred from the offset plate to a rubber blanket, and then onto a sheet of paper. It is an indirect process of reproducing the printing form onto the printing substrate.
The greatest advantage of offset printing is the top print quality and a very favourable price for larger print runs.
Digital printing
Digital printing is a popular and modern printing method which transfers the given motif onto paper using a laser.

Digital printing significantly simplifies the printing process, because it enables the printing of small and medium runs, without making films and plates as is the case in offset printing. The advantages of digital printing are small print runs, speed and imprint quality.

hr.name: Memorandumi

content.text: Standardni format memoranduma je A4 (210 x 297 mm), ali ukoliko se radi o memorandumu za specijalnu namjenu može biti i drugih formata, a papir za tisak memoranduma je najčešće offsetni 80 ili 90gr.
Kod većeg broja komada preporuča se offset tisak kojim se postiže visoko kvalitetan otisak, dok za manji broj komada preporuča se digitalni tisak.
Offsetni tisak

Offsetni tisak je tehnika tiska u kojoj se tisak transferira sa offsetne ploče na gumeni plašt, a zatim na arak papira.
To je indirektni postupak umnožavanja tiskovne forme na tiskovnu podlogu.
Najveća prednost offsetnog tiska je vrhunska kvaliteta otiska i vrlo povoljna cijena za veće naklade.
Digitalni tisak
Digitalni tisak je popularna i moderna metoda tiskanja koja digitalni tisak pomoću lasera prenosi zadani motiv na papir.

Digitalni tisak znatno pojednostavljuje tiskarski proces, jer omogućuje tisak malih i srednjih naklada, bez izrade filmova i ploča kao što je slučaj u offsetnom tisku. Prednosti digitalnog tiska su mala naklada, brzina i kvaliteta otiska.

content.text: A poster is a printed promotional material most often used in promoting various products, services, advertising new products or various events such as a concert, exhibition, fair, event...
A poster is a printed promotional material most often used in promoting various products, services, advertising new products or various events such as a concert, exhibition, fair, event...
The standard poster sizes are: A3 (29.7x42cm), B2 (50x70cm), B1 (70x100cm), but we also make them in various other dimensions according to your wishes.
Depending on quantity, posters are printed in offset or digital print.
Offset printing

Offset printing is a printing technique in which the print is transferred from the offset plate to a rubber blanket, and then onto a sheet of paper. It is an indirect process of reproducing the printing form onto the printing substrate.
The greatest advantage of offset printing is the top print quality and a very favourable price for larger print runs.
Digital printing
Digital printing is a popular and modern printing method which transfers the given motif onto paper using a laser.

Digital printing significantly simplifies the printing process, because it enables the printing of small and medium runs, without making films and plates as is the case in offset printing. The advantages of digital printing are small print runs, speed and imprint quality.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

hr.name: Plakati

content.text: Plakat je tiskani promotivni materijal koji se najčešće koristi u promociji raznih proizvoda, usluga, reklamiranja novih proizvoda ili raznih događanja poput koncerta, izložbe, sajma, eventa...
Osnovne veličine plakata su: A3 (29,7x42cm), B2 (50x70cm), B1 (70x100cm), ali izrađujemo i u raznim drugim dimenzijama prema vašim željama.
Ovisno o količini, plakati se tiskaju u offset tisku ili digitalnim printom.
Offsetni tisak

Offsetni tisak je tehnika tiska u kojoj se tisak transferira sa offsetne ploče na gumeni plašt, a zatim na arak papira.
To je indirektni postupak umnožavanja tiskovne forme na tiskovnu podlogu.
Najveća prednost offsetnog tiska je vrhunska kvaliteta otiska i vrlo povoljna cijena za veće naklade.
Digitalni tisak
Digitalni tisak je popularna i moderna metoda tiskanja koja digitalni tisak pomoću lasera prenosi zadani motiv na papir.

Digitalni tisak znatno pojednostavljuje tiskarski proces, jer omogućuje tisak malih i srednjih naklada, bez izrade filmova i ploča kao što je slučaj u offsetnom tisku. Prednosti digitalnog tiska su mala naklada, brzina i kvaliteta otiska.
Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

Kod crnih ploha, 100% crna boja nije dovoljna da bi dobili jaču i tamniju crnu boju. Za punoću crne boje koristite CMYK boju koji se sastoji od: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. Ovo ne vrijedi za datoteke namijenjene za print na tekstil, odnosno sublimacijom, tada mora biti crna C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

Za izradu verlauf (prijelaz, gradijent) preporučujemo da ga napravite unutar Photoshop-a jer vektorski generirani gradijenti imaju problema prilikom RIP-anja i često dolazi do pojave “stepenica” u rasponu gradijenta (kako bi bili potpuno sigurni da smo izbjegli mogućnost stepenica dobro je napraviti "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) na gradijentu).
Veličina, napusti i margine datoteke
Datoteke kreirajte u njihovoj stvarnoj konačnoj dimenziji sa napustima.
Povećanje manjeg formata datoteke na veći format može dovesti do smanjenja kvalitete razlučivosti. Na primjer, povećanje A6 letka na letak A4, može utjecati na kvalitetu vašeg konačog proizvoda.

Uvijek dodajte napust (bleed) na konačnu dimenziju datoteke jer ćete time olakšati kod rezanja na format i neće se pojavljivati bijeli obrub Napust neka iznosi 3mm preko ruba završenog formata osim ako nije drugačije definirano u uputi za grafičku priprema za taj proizvod.
Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.
Slike, grafike, tekst i linije
Svi rasterski elementi grafičke pripreme trebali bi biti oko:
30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),
60 do 100 dpi za formate A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 (plakati, posteri, pultevi, roll upovi, banneri…),
100 do 150 dpi za format A3 (manji plakati, slike…),
200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.
Linije trebaju biti debljine barem 0.125 pt
Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke
Preferiramo dostavu dokumenata u pdf ili tif formatu. Prihvaćamo i slijedeće formate datoteka za digitalni tisak: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Uz datoteku s grafičkom pripremom, molimo pošaljite i preview niže rezolucije (.jpg).

content.text: We make 3D letters as three-dimensional letter models.
We make the letters with background (indirect) or frontal lighting.
For sign lighting we use exclusively quality LED diodes and power supplies
By using different materials, the letters can have a side edge of aluminium, stainless steel, or plexiglass of the desired depth and colour.
LED diodes are placed inside the letters, illuminating the letter directly on the face or indirectly so the background of the letter glows.
3D letters can also be non-illuminated for placement in interiors; the letters can be made of styrofoam, plexiglass, PVC, wood, brass, stainless steel, etc...

hr.name: 3D slova

content.text: Korištenjem različitih materijala, slova mogu imati bočni rub od aluminija, inoxa, pleksiglasa željene dubine i boje.
Unutar slova postavljaju se LED diode koje osvjetljavaju slovo direktno na lice ili indirektno da svijetli pozadina slova.
3D slova mogu biti i neosvijetljena za postavljanje u interijerima, slova mogu biti od stiropora, pleksiglasa, PVC-a, drva, mesinga, inoxa, itd...

hr.description:
3D slova izrađujemo kao trodimenzionalne modele slova.
Slova izrađujemo sa pozadinskom (indirektnom) ili frontalnom rasvjetom.

Za rasvjetu reklama koristimo isključivo kvalitetne LED diode i napajanja

content.text: Modern, quality umbrellas with a wooden or plastic handle, in various colours.
An umbrella with your logo is an unfailing gift for your business associates and customers because it is something they will always need.
Modern, quality umbrellas with a wooden or plastic handle, in various colours.
We offer umbrellas of various colours, dimensions and quality, automatic or manual, and folding or classic.
Download catalogue
Screen printing

Screen printing is the oldest printing technique with a wide application, especially for finished advertising or printed products. It is used for printing on various materials, e.g. printing on textile, metal, PVC substrates, ceramics, rubber or various promotional articles.
Screen printing is distinguished by a long imprint lifespan in all conditions of use and high coverage, so that a quality screen print has many years of use without damage.

hr.name: Kišobrani

content.text: Moderni i kvalitetni kišobrani sa drvenom ili plastičnom ručkom, u raznim bojama.
U ponudi imamo kišobrane raznih boja, dimenzija i kvalitete, automatske ili ručne, te sklopive ili klasične.
Sitotisak

Sitotisak je najstarija tehnika tiska koja ima široku primjenu, posebno kod gotovih reklamnih ili tiskanih proizvoda.
Koristi za tisak na razne materijale kao npr. tisak na tekstil, metal, PVC podloge, keramiku, gumu ili različite promotivne artikle.
Sitotisak odlikuje dugi vijek trajanja otiska u svim uvjetima korištenja i velika pokrivnost, tako da kvalitetno izvedene tisak u sitotisku ima višegodišnju upotrebu bez oštećenja.

content.text: We make colour stickers or labels printed by digital print on self-adhesive paper or PVC films.
The durability of the sticker depends on the material it is printed on and the conditions to which the sticker itself will be exposed, so it can vary from a few months to several years.
Wine labels, stickers, PVC stickers, die-cut stickers, labels and declarations for various products, bottle labels.
The price of stickers depends on dimensions, type of stickers, finishing and quantity, so please contact us for an exact price.
Digital printing
Digital printing is a popular and modern printing method which transfers the given motif onto paper using a laser.

Digital printing significantly simplifies the printing process, because it enables the printing of small and medium runs, without making films and plates as is the case in offset printing. The advantages of digital printing are small print runs, speed and imprint quality.
Offset printing

Offset printing is a printing technique in which the print is transferred from the offset plate to a rubber blanket, and then onto a sheet of paper. It is an indirect process of reproducing the printing form onto the printing substrate.
The greatest advantage of offset printing is the top print quality and a very favourable price for larger print runs.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

hr.name: Etikete / naljepnice

content.text: Etikete za vino, naljepnice, PVC naljepnice, štancane naljepnice, naljepnice i deklaracije za razne proizvode, etikete za boce.
Cijena naljepnica ovisi o dimenzijama, vrsti naljepnica, doradi, količini te Vas molimo da nas kontaktirate za točnu cijenu.
Digitalni tisak
Digitalni tisak je popularna i moderna metoda tiskanja koja digitalni tisak pomoću lasera prenosi zadani motiv na papir.

Digitalni tisak znatno pojednostavljuje tiskarski proces, jer omogućuje tisak malih i srednjih naklada, bez izrade filmova i ploča kao što je slučaj u offsetnom tisku. Prednosti digitalnog tiska su mala naklada, brzina i kvaliteta otiska.
Offsetni tisak

Offsetni tisak je tehnika tiska u kojoj se tisak transferira sa offsetne ploče na gumeni plašt, a zatim na arak papira.
To je indirektni postupak umnožavanja tiskovne forme na tiskovnu podlogu.
Najveća prednost offsetnog tiska je vrhunska kvaliteta otiska i vrlo povoljna cijena za veće naklade.
Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

Kod crnih ploha, 100% crna boja nije dovoljna da bi dobili jaču i tamniju crnu boju. Za punoću crne boje koristite CMYK boju koji se sastoji od: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. Ovo ne vrijedi za datoteke namijenjene za print na tekstil, odnosno sublimacijom, tada mora biti crna C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

Za izradu verlauf (prijelaz, gradijent) preporučujemo da ga napravite unutar Photoshop-a jer vektorski generirani gradijenti imaju problema prilikom RIP-anja i često dolazi do pojave “stepenica” u rasponu gradijenta (kako bi bili potpuno sigurni da smo izbjegli mogućnost stepenica dobro je napraviti "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) na gradijentu).
Veličina, napusti i margine datoteke
Datoteke kreirajte u njihovoj stvarnoj konačnoj dimenziji sa napustima.
Povećanje manjeg formata datoteke na veći format može dovesti do smanjenja kvalitete razlučivosti. Na primjer, povećanje A6 letka na letak A4, može utjecati na kvalitetu vašeg konačog proizvoda.

Uvijek dodajte napust (bleed) na konačnu dimenziju datoteke jer ćete time olakšati kod rezanja na format i neće se pojavljivati bijeli obrub Napust neka iznosi 3mm preko ruba završenog formata osim ako nije drugačije definirano u uputi za grafičku priprema za taj proizvod.
Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.
Slike, grafike, tekst i linije
Svi rasterski elementi grafičke pripreme trebali bi biti oko:
30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),
60 do 100 dpi za formate A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 (plakati, posteri, pultevi, roll upovi, banneri…),
100 do 150 dpi za format A3 (manji plakati, slike…),
200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.
Linije trebaju biti debljine barem 0.125 pt
Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke
Preferiramo dostavu dokumenata u pdf ili tif formatu. Prihvaćamo i slijedeće formate datoteka za digitalni tisak: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Uz datoteku s grafičkom pripremom, molimo pošaljite i preview niže rezolucije (.jpg).

content.text: We make all kinds of illuminated signs: box, totems, LED display, block letters with frontal or background lighting, citylight boxes.
For sign lighting we use exclusively quality LED diodes and power supplies
We produce illuminated signs in two basic categories: single-sided and double-sided.
Single-sided illuminated signs are mounted directly on the wall, so the sign is visible only from the front.
For double-sided illuminated signs, the sign is placed on two sides, and the sign is fastened to the wall with mounts.
We make the frame of illuminated signs from aluminium profiles reinforced with an iron sub-structure.
The face of the illuminated sign frame is made of plexiglass and printed with a light-transmitting film.

content.text: Writing instruments are one of the most affordable and widespread ways to promote your company, product or service.
We also offer the option of overprinting your logo or advertising message on pens.
Our wide range includes pens of various materials – plastic, metal or combinations thereof.
We print on ballpoint pens using pad printing, or on metal pens by engraving.
Download catalogue
UV digital printing
Nocai UL 600 is the latest technique of direct printing on various types of flat products and slightly curved/relief substrates.

Its greatest advantage is that, in addition to the basic colours, it can print with white ink and UV varnish. With multiple layers of ink a relief print can be achieved. The work table size is 70x90cm and 60cm high.
Pad printing
Pad printing is a gravure technique with indirect imprinting, where, using a rubber pad, we transfer ink from the printing form, the cliché, onto the desired object.

We use this type of printing for printing flat and curved surfaces of objects made of various materials such as plastic, glass, ceramics, rubber, metal. The most common articles for pad printing are pens, keyrings, lighters, mugs, ashtrays and similar promotional articles.
Laser engraving
Laser engraving is the process of incising text and/or graphics with a laser beam onto a suitable substrate.

The advantage of engraving is that it takes place using a laser beam, without direct contact with the substrate being engraved. This enables top precision, high resolution of the engraved content, high production speed, and the engraved content is long-lasting.

hr.name: Pisaći pribor

content.text: U našoj širokoj ponudi imamo olovke od raznih materijala – plastike, metala ili njihovih kombinacija.
Tisak na kemijske olovke vršimo u tehnici tampon tiska, ili na metalne olovke graviranjem.
UV digitalni tisak
Nocai UL 600 je najnovija tehnika direktnog tisak na razne vrste plošnih proizvoda i blago zakrivljenih/reljefnih podloga.

Njegova najveća prednost je što osim osnovnih boja ima mogućnost tiska bijelom bojom i UV lakom.
Sa više slojeva boje moguće je dobiti reljefni tisak. Veličina radne ploče je 70x90cm i visine 60cm.
Tampon tisak
Tampon tisak je tehnika dubokog tiska sa indirektnim otiskivanjem, gdje pomoću gumenog tampona prenosimo boju sa tiskovne forme, klišea, na željeni predmet.

Ovu vrstu tiska koristimo za tisak ravnih i zakrivljenih površina predmeta izrađenih od raznih materijala kao što su plastika,
staklo, keramika, guma, metal. Najčešći artikli za tampon tisak su olovke, privjesci, upaljači, šalice, pepeljare i sl promotivni artikli.
Lasersko graviranje
Lasersko graviranje je postupak urezivanja teksta i/ili grafike laserskom zrakom na prikladnu podlogu.

Prednost graviranje je taj što se odvija upotrebom laserske zrake, bez neposrednog kontakta s podlogom na koju se gravira.
To omogućuje vrhunsku preciznost, veliku razlučivost graviranog sadržaja, veliku brzinu izrade te je gravirani sadržaj dugotrajan.

We offer all types of envelopes, from business American format, C5, C4, A5, A4, B5, B4 white strip, in 80, 90 or more grams.
We offer all types of envelopes, from business American format, C5, C4, A5, A4, B5, B4 white strip, in 80, 90 or more grams.

Overprinting on envelopes is possible on almost all types, but depending on the print requirement itself it is determined whether it will be printed in offset, digital print, etc. For larger numbers of pieces, offset printing is recommended, which achieves a high-quality imprint, while for smaller numbers digital printing is recommended.
Offset printing

Offset printing is a printing technique in which the print is transferred from the offset plate to a rubber blanket, and then onto a sheet of paper. It is an indirect process of reproducing the printing form onto the printing substrate.
The greatest advantage of offset printing is the top print quality and a very favourable price for larger print runs.
Digital printing
Digital printing is a popular and modern printing method which transfers the given motif onto paper using a laser.

Digital printing significantly simplifies the printing process, because it enables the printing of small and medium runs, without making films and plates as is the case in offset printing. The advantages of digital printing are small print runs, speed and imprint quality.

content.text: U ponudi imamo sve vrste kuverti, od poslovnih American formata, C5,C4,A5, A4, B5, B4 bijele strip, u 80, 90 ili više grama.

Digitalni tisak

content.text: A large selection of modern and classic planners and notebooks with the option of overprinting on the covers of the planners and notebooks.
Planners and notebooks come in various sizes, most often A4 for the planner and A5 for the notebook.
Planners and notebooks come in various sizes, most often A4 for the planner and A5 for the notebook.
For all planners and notebooks in our range, we offer the option of printing on the cover using screen printing, foil stamping or digital UV printing.
Download catalogue
Screen printing

Screen printing is the oldest printing technique with a wide application, especially for finished advertising or printed products. It is used for printing on various materials, e.g. printing on textile, metal, PVC substrates, ceramics, rubber or various promotional articles.
Screen printing is distinguished by a long imprint lifespan in all conditions of use and high coverage, so that a quality screen print has many years of use without damage.
Foil or gold stamping
Foil or gold stamping is a relief-printing technique. The imprint is obtained by transferring ink from a special foil under the influence of temperature and pressure.

With this printing technique your promotional products become a special and exclusive product. It is most often used when printing invitations, packaging, business folders, business cards, thank-you cards, diplomas, planners, etc.
UV digital printing
Nocai UL 600 is the latest technique of direct printing on various types of flat products and slightly curved/relief substrates.

Its greatest advantage is that, in addition to the basic colours, it can print with white ink and UV varnish. With multiple layers of ink a relief print can be achieved. The work table size is 70x90cm and 60cm high.

content.text: Rokovnici i notesi dolaze u raznim veličinama, najčešće je to A4 za rokovnik te A5 za notes.
Na sve rokovnike i notese iz ponude, nudimo mogućnost otiska na korice u tehnici sitotiska, foliotiska ili digitalnog UV tiska.
Sitotisak

Sitotisak je najstarija tehnika tiska koja ima široku primjenu, posebno kod gotovih reklamnih ili tiskanih proizvoda.
Koristi za tisak na razne materijale kao npr. tisak na tekstil, metal, PVC podloge, keramiku, gumu ili različite promotivne artikle.
Sitotisak odlikuje dugi vijek trajanja otiska u svim uvjetima korištenja i velika pokrivnost, tako da kvalitetno izvedene tisak u sitotisku ima višegodišnju upotrebu bez oštećenja.
Foliotisak ili zlatotisak
Foliotisak ili zlatotisak je tehnika visokog tiska. Otisak se dobiva prijenosom bojila sa specijalne folije pod utjecajem temperature i pritiska.

Ovom tehnikom tiska vaši promotivni proizvodi postaju poseban i ekskluzivan proizvod.
Najviše se primjenjuje prilikom tiska pozivnica, ambalaže, poslovne mape, vizit karte, zahvalnice, diplome, rokovnici i sl.

Nocai UL 600 je najnovija tehnika direktnog tisak na razne vrste plošnih proizvoda i blago zakrivljenih/reljefnih podloga.

Njegova najveća prednost je što osim osnovnih boja ima mogućnost tiska bijelom bojom i UV lakom.
Sa više slojeva boje moguće je dobiti reljefni tisak. Veličina radne ploče je 70x90cm i visine 60cm.

content.text: We make price lists for cafés, clubs, restaurants and other hospitality establishments.
We use various types of paper (different weights, structures and finenesses) and synthetic materials that are waterproof and tear-proof.
The special synthetic paper is tear-proof, resistant to grease, moisture and heat, i.e. ideal for making price lists and menus.
Printing on classic paper plus additional lamination over the edge, in a glossy or matte finish, significantly extends the lifespan of the price list.

Various price-list finishes are possible, such as foil stamping (gold stamping), matte and glossy lamination, laminating two types of material, rounding, cutting into the desired shape, creasing (folding along lines), and blind embossing (blind print)
Offset printing

Offset printing is a printing technique in which the print is transferred from the offset plate to a rubber blanket, and then onto a sheet of paper. It is an indirect process of reproducing the printing form onto the printing substrate.
The greatest advantage of offset printing is the top print quality and a very favourable price for larger print runs.
Digital printing
Digital printing is a popular and modern printing method which transfers the given motif onto paper using a laser.

Digital printing significantly simplifies the printing process, because it enables the printing of small and medium runs, without making films and plates as is the case in offset printing. The advantages of digital printing are small print runs, speed and imprint quality.
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

content.text: Specijalni sintetički papir je nepoderiv, otporan na masnoću, vlagu i toplinu, tj. idealan je za izradu cjenika i jelovnika.
Ispis na klasičnom papiru te dodatna plastifikacija preko ruba, u sjajnoj ili matiranoj obradi, znatno produžuje vijek trajanja cjenika.

Moguće su razne dorade cjenika kao što je foliotisak (zlatotisak), mat i sjajna plastifikacija, laminiranje dvije vrste materijala, rundanje, izrezivanje u željeni oblik, biganje (presavijanje po linijama, te slijepi tisak (blindruck)
