Digitalni tisak znatno pojednostavljuje tiskarski proces, jer omogućuje tisak malih i srednjih naklada, bez izrade filmova i ploča kao što je slučaj u offsetnom tisku. Prednosti digitalnog tiska su mala naklada, brzina i kvaliteta otiska.
Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

Kod crnih ploha, 100% crna boja nije dovoljna da bi dobili jaču i tamniju crnu boju. Za punoću crne boje koristite CMYK boju koji se sastoji od: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. Ovo ne vrijedi za datoteke namijenjene za print na tekstil, odnosno sublimacijom, tada mora biti crna C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

Za izradu verlauf (prijelaz, gradijent) preporučujemo da ga napravite unutar Photoshop-a jer vektorski generirani gradijenti imaju problema prilikom RIP-anja i često dolazi do pojave “stepenica” u rasponu gradijenta (kako bi bili potpuno sigurni da smo izbjegli mogućnost stepenica dobro je napraviti "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) na gradijentu).
Veličina, napusti i margine datoteke
Datoteke kreirajte u njihovoj stvarnoj konačnoj dimenziji sa napustima.
Povećanje manjeg formata datoteke na veći format može dovesti do smanjenja kvalitete razlučivosti. Na primjer, povećanje A6 letka na letak A4, može utjecati na kvalitetu vašeg konačog proizvoda.

Uvijek dodajte napust (bleed) na konačnu dimenziju datoteke jer ćete time olakšati kod rezanja na format i neće se pojavljivati bijeli obrub Napust neka iznosi 3mm preko ruba završenog formata osim ako nije drugačije definirano u uputi za grafičku priprema za taj proizvod.
Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.
Slike, grafike, tekst i linije
Svi rasterski elementi grafičke pripreme trebali bi biti oko:
30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),
60 do 100 dpi za formate A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 (plakati, posteri, pultevi, roll upovi, banneri…),
100 do 150 dpi za format A3 (manji plakati, slike…),
200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.
Linije trebaju biti debljine barem 0.125 pt
Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke
Preferiramo dostavu dokumenata u pdf ili tif formatu. Prihvaćamo i slijedeće formate datoteka za digitalni tisak: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Uz datoteku s grafičkom pripremom, molimo pošaljite i preview niže rezolucije (.jpg).

content.text: Document folders are most often used for carrying or storing documents, not rarely for presentation purposes and for fairs; they are made of heavier paper and can be additionally laminated (matte or gloss)

For larger numbers of pieces, offset printing is recommended, which achieves a high-quality imprint, while for smaller numbers digital printing is recommended.
Offset printing

Offset printing is a printing technique in which the print is transferred from the offset plate to a rubber blanket, and then onto a sheet of paper. It is an indirect process of reproducing the printing form onto the printing substrate.
The greatest advantage of offset printing is the top print quality and a very favourable price for larger print runs.
Digital printing
Digital printing is a popular and modern printing method which transfers the given motif onto paper using a laser.

Digital printing significantly simplifies the printing process, because it enables the printing of small and medium runs, without making films and plates as is the case in offset printing. The advantages of digital printing are small print runs, speed and imprint quality.

Offsetni tisak

Offsetni tisak je tehnika tiska u kojoj se tisak transferira sa offsetne ploče na gumeni plašt, a zatim na arak papira.
To je indirektni postupak umnožavanja tiskovne forme na tiskovnu podlogu.
Najveća prednost offsetnog tiska je vrhunska kvaliteta otiska i vrlo povoljna cijena za veće naklade.
Digitalni tisak
Digitalni tisak je popularna i moderna metoda tiskanja koja digitalni tisak pomoću lasera prenosi zadani motiv na papir.

Digitalni tisak znatno pojednostavljuje tiskarski proces, jer omogućuje tisak malih i srednjih naklada, bez izrade filmova i ploča kao što je slučaj u offsetnom tisku. Prednosti digitalnog tiska su mala naklada, brzina i kvaliteta otiska.

When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

content.text: The protective roll-up partition is an affordable yet effective protective-partition option for workplaces where there is close contact with clients.

They are intended for hotels, hospitality establishments, hairdressing salons, surgeries, pharmacies, offices and other activities in order to prevent infection and the spread of the corona virus COVID-19.

en.name: Freestanding disinfectant stand with advertising frame

content.text: The freestanding stand for disinfectant is assembled easily and quickly by gluing with double-sided tape to an aluminium profile, which is then connected to a sturdy base and a klik-klak frame.
The stand consists of a PVC bottle 500ml with a pump set into a plexiglass frame 3mm thick, and the bottle cannot be removed from the frame.
Overprinting on the stand as desired; for larger quantities a change of plexiglass colour is possible.
Print size: 87x154 mm
The price includes the first fill of alcohol-based ALCOSAN disinfectant
- material plexi 3mm
- fastening to the profile using double-sided adhesive tape
- PVC bottle 500ml with pump - UV print
- first fill of alcohol-based ALCOSAN disinfectant
- Aluminium profile 50x30mm length 150cm
- Metal base 250x250mm powder-coated grey
- Klik-klak frame A4 format
When creating artwork, there are a few things you should keep in mind in order to create correct artwork, so we have put together a few tips and guidelines.
If you are not sure how best to prepare a document for our printing, feel free to call us on 098 9085 552 and we will gladly help with our advice.
Colours and gradients in the file

Prepare the supplied files using CMYK colours, never RGB, and if within your document you use colours that are not CMYK but RGB they will be converted to CMYK, in which case minor or major deviations in the fidelity of colour reproduction are possible, for which we accept no responsibility.
Avoid 4C for black; instead it is sufficient that it is 100% K (black).
When using special colours (Pantone or HKS) please note this specifically when ordering.
Check that all overlapping objects are set correctly (overprint).
If you order a file in grey, we recommend that the grey be created in shades of black.
White must be a separate spot colour, with the mandatory name “White_Ink“ (mind upper and lower case), in overprint and in the top layer.

For black areas, 100% black is not enough to obtain a stronger and darker black. For richness of black, use a CMYK colour consisting of: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. This does not apply to files intended for printing on textile, i.e. by sublimation; then the black must be C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

For making a verlauf (transition, gradient) we recommend that you make it within Photoshop, because vector-generated gradients have problems during RIPping and "steps" often appear across the gradient range (to be completely sure we have avoided the possibility of steps, it is good to apply an "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) to the gradient).
File size, bleed and margins
Create the files at their actual final dimensions with bleed.
Enlarging a smaller file format to a larger format can lead to a reduction in resolution quality. For example, enlarging an A6 leaflet to an A4 leaflet can affect the quality of your final product.

Always add bleed to the final file dimension, because this will make cutting to format easier and no white border will appear. The bleed should be 3mm over the edge of the finished format unless otherwise defined in the artwork-preparation instructions for that product.
Bleed is defined for all four sides regardless of the page position (left, right) and the type of binding.
Pages are sent individually, centred on the output format. There can be several in one document, but only with crop marks; all other marks are superfluous.
All content should be at least 5mm from the cut line; for some products a safe zone is defined (pink line)
For background colours or images, if they go to the edge of the product, leave a bleed.
Images, graphics, text and lines
All raster elements of the artwork should be around:
30 dpi for XXL formats over 12 m2 (jumbo posters, megaboards…),
60 to 100 dpi for A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 formats (posters, prints, counters, roll ups, banners…),
100 to 150 dpi for A3 format (smaller posters, images…),
200 to 300 dpi for A4, A5 formats (catalogues, brochures, business cards…).
Logos, text, lines, etc. should be in vector format
If the artwork contains text, convert all text to curves or send the font used for PC.

Files should be at a 1:1 ratio for smaller visuals or 1:10 for large visuals; if the artwork is not at 1:1 scale, then it is necessary to state at what scale it was made and what the final dimension is.
Lines should be at least 0.125 pt thick

Please adjust the lines so they are visible when printed; depending on the material being produced, the thickness should be adjusted accordingly - greater thickness on flags, while a thinner line on a leaflet.
File format
We prefer documents to be supplied in pdf or tif format. We also accept the following file formats for digital printing: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Along with the artwork file, please also send a lower-resolution preview (.jpg).

stalak_za_dezinficijens.pdf
Prilikom stvaranja grafičkih priprema, nekoliko stvari trebate imati na umu kako bi kreirali ispravnu grafičku priprema stoga smo sastavili nekoliko savjeta i smjernica.
Ukoliko niste sigurni kako najbolje pripremiti dokument za naš tisak slobodno nas nazovite na telefon 098 9085 552 te ćemo rado pomoći svojim savjetima.
Boje i gradijenti u datoteci

Dostavljene datoteke pripremite koristeći CMYK boje, a nikako RGB, a ako unutar vašeg dokumenta koristite boje koje nisu CMYK nego RGB one će biti konvertirani u CMYK prilikom čega su mogući manji ili veći odmaci u vjernosti reprodukcije boja i za što nepreuzimamo odgovornost.
Izbjegavajte 4C za crnu boju; umjesto toga dovoljno je da je 100% K (crna).
Kada koristite specijalne boje (Pantone ili HKS) molimo vas da posebno napomenete kod narudžbe.
Provjerite da li su svi objekti koji se preklapaju ispravno podešeni (overprint).
Ako naručite datoteku u sivoj boji, tada preporučujemo da je siva stvorena u nijansama crne.
Bijela boja mora biti zasebna spot boja, obaveznog naziva “White_Ink“ (paziti na velika i mala slova), u overprintu i u top layeru.

Kod crnih ploha, 100% crna boja nije dovoljna da bi dobili jaču i tamniju crnu boju. Za punoću crne boje koristite CMYK boju koji se sastoji od: C: 40% ; M: 40% ; Y: 40% ; K: 100%. Ovo ne vrijedi za datoteke namijenjene za print na tekstil, odnosno sublimacijom, tada mora biti crna C: 0% ; M: 0% ; Y: 0% ; K: 100%.

Za izradu verlauf (prijelaz, gradijent) preporučujemo da ga napravite unutar Photoshop-a jer vektorski generirani gradijenti imaju problema prilikom RIP-anja i često dolazi do pojave “stepenica” u rasponu gradijenta (kako bi bili potpuno sigurni da smo izbjegli mogućnost stepenica dobro je napraviti "Add noise" filter (max. 2-3) na gradijentu).
Veličina, napusti i margine datoteke
Datoteke kreirajte u njihovoj stvarnoj konačnoj dimenziji sa napustima.
Povećanje manjeg formata datoteke na veći format može dovesti do smanjenja kvalitete razlučivosti. Na primjer, povećanje A6 letka na letak A4, može utjecati na kvalitetu vašeg konačog proizvoda.

Uvijek dodajte napust (bleed) na konačnu dimenziju datoteke jer ćete time olakšati kod rezanja na format i neće se pojavljivati bijeli obrub Napust neka iznosi 3mm preko ruba završenog formata osim ako nije drugačije definirano u uputi za grafičku priprema za taj proizvod.
Napusti se definiraju za sve četiri strane bez obzira na poziciju stranice (lijeva, desna), te vrstu uveza.
Stranice se šalju pojedinačno centrirane na izlazni format Može ih biti i više u jednom dokumentu, ali samo s oznakama reza, sve ostale oznake su suvišne.
Sav sadržaj treba biti barem 5mm od linije reza; kod nekih proizvoda je definirana sigurna zona (roza linija)
Kod pozadinskih boja ili slika, ukoliko idu do ruba proizvoda, tada ostavite napust.
Slike, grafike, tekst i linije
Svi rasterski elementi grafičke pripreme trebali bi biti oko:
30 dpi za XXL formate preko 12 m2 (jumbo plakati, megaboardi…),
60 do 100 dpi za formate A0, A1, B0, B1, B2 (plakati, posteri, pultevi, roll upovi, banneri…),
100 do 150 dpi za format A3 (manji plakati, slike…),
200 do 300 dpi za formate A4, A5 (katalozi, prospekti, vizitke…).
Logotipovi, tekstovi, linije i sl. trebaju biti u vektorskom obliku
Ako priprema sadrži tekst, sav tekst pretvoriti u krivulje ili poslati korišteni font za PC.

Datoteke neka budu u omjeru 1:1 za manje vizuale ili 1:10 za velike vizuale; ukoliko priprema nije u 1:1 mjerilu, tada je potrebno naglasiti u kojem je mjerilu napravljena i koja je finalna dimenzija.
Linije trebaju biti debljine barem 0.125 pt
Molimo da linije prilagodite tako da budu vidljive kod tiska; ovisno na kojem materijalu se izrađuje shodno treba i podesiti debljinu-na zastavama veća debljina dok na letku tanja linija.
Format datoteke
Preferiramo dostavu dokumenata u pdf ili tif formatu. Prihvaćamo i slijedeće formate datoteka za digitalni tisak: .JPG, EPS, .AI, .PSD, .CDR
Uz datoteku s grafičkom pripremom, molimo pošaljite i preview niže rezolucije (.jpg).
